transcript_title: Analyzing tidying and analyzing US PhDs in R

source_files.transcript_file: raw-data/inspiration/Analyzing tidying and analyzing US PhDs in R.txt

analysis_intent: Explore distributions, group differences, and notable patterns in tidying and analyzing US PhDs through cleaning, summarization, and visualization
fails_when: dataset has no natural grouping variable — comparisons become meaningless
column names are unstable across TidyTuesday editions (re-check schema each year)
irregular time intervals inflate or deflate apparent trends
works_when: dataset has clear categorical + numeric columns for grouped comparisons
question is exploratory — no strong prior hypothesis
time dimension is regular and spans multiple periods with meaningful change

steps: Build 3-4 core ggplot charts telling the main story
Fit linear model on main numeric outcome
Compute bootstrap confidence intervals for key estimates
Test for interaction effects between top 2 grouping vars
Quarto doc: tidying_phds_report.qmd with params for data year
Hero chart: single best visualisation at 1200×628 (social media ratio)
Instagram carousel: 5 slides (hook → data → insight → method → CTA)
Shiny widget or Observable/D3 for one interactive element
TheDataShrink™ post template: title, 3 bullets, hashtags, link to episode page
